The theory that authoritarian governments can ______ (111) ______ policy consensus more easily than multiparty democracies holds some ____(112) ______. The case of Asia’s hyper-growth economies suggests what is important isn’t ______(115)_____ itself, but what policies the autocrat chooses to impose—and, more importantly, to whom he listens. Historically, Asia’s most successful strongmen have all benefited from ______ (116)_____ sound economic guidance. In South Korea, long-serving ruler Park Chung-hee ______ (117) ______ that top economic posts be filled by highly ______(118) ______ economists and other professionals. As one study put it, “Though political agencies in the early Park regime were ______(119) ______ by the military, economic agencies generally were not. Rather, under Park the _____(120)_____ of economics experts in the Korean government rose considerably.”
questions.stem: Select the word that fits blank (111).
